question: A shirt is discounted by 20% from a price of 1,000. The discounted price is 800.
A quantity increases from 80 to 100. Its percentage increase is 20%.
The average of five numbers is 18. Their total sum is 90.
If 30% of a number is 45, then the number is 135.
A car travels 120 km in 2 hours and then 60 km in 1 hour. Its average speed for the entire journey is 60 km/h.
If x/3 = 8, then x = 24.
A price is increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%. The final price is equal to the original price.
If two positive numbers have an arithmetic mean of 10, their product must be 100.
A student scores 60, 70, and 80 on three equally weighted tests. The student's average score is 70.
A value is increased by 50% and then increased by another 50%. The total increase relative to the original value is 100%.
If every A is a B and every B is a C, then every A is a C.
If P implies Q and P is false, then Q must be false.
If P implies Q and Q is true, then P must be true.
If P implies Q and Q is false, then P must be false.
If all engineers are graduates, then anyone who is not a graduate cannot be an engineer.
If some A are B, then every A is B.
If no A are B and some C are A, then those C cannot be B.
If every A is B and some B are C, then some A are C.
If P is necessary for Q, then whenever Q is true, P must be true.
If P is sufficient for Q, then whenever Q is true, P must be true.
A classifier makes 90 correct predictions out of 100 predictions. Its accuracy is 90%.
A classifier has 90 true positives and 10 false positives. Its precision is 90%.
A dataset contains the values 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. Its median is 6.
A dataset contains the values 1, 2, 100, and 101. Its mean is 51.
If every value in a dataset is multiplied by 2, the variance is also multiplied by 2.
A model with precision 0.8 and recall 0.8 has an F1 score of 0.8.
If two variables have correlation 0.9, then changing the first variable causes the second variable to change.
If a classifier has 100 true positives and 100 false negatives, its recall is 50%.
Adding the same constant to every observation changes the standard deviation of the dataset.
A model can have high accuracy while performing poorly on a minority class in an imbalanced dataset.
If an object has greater mass but the same acceleration as another object, the greater-mass object experiences a greater net force.
If a reaction is exothermic, the products necessarily contain more chemical energy than the reactants.
If all metals in a particular experiment conduct electricity and copper is a metal in that experiment, copper conducts electricity.
If a substance has a density lower than water, it must sink in water.
If an object moves at constant velocity, its acceleration is zero.
If two objects are at the same temperature, they must contain the same amount of thermal energy.
If all organisms in a population are exposed to the same environmental change and only organisms with trait X survive, then trait X is necessarily the only trait responsible for survival.
If a sample contains only substance A and substance B, and 40% of the sample is A by mass, then 60% is B by mass.
If increasing temperature increases the rate of a particular chemical reaction in one experiment, then increasing temperature must increase the rate of every chemical reaction.
If two isolated systems are each individually at thermal equilibrium, they must have the same temperature.
